# Terrain and resources

The terrains and resources of the current rules, what can be built on them, and which techs open them up. The map is generated by [map generation](../map-generation.md); movement is in [movement](../movement.md).

## Terrain

| Terrain | idx | Resources that can spawn | Improvements built on it | Entered once known | Defence bonus tech |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `none` | 0 | - | - | - | - |
| `water` | 1 | `fish`, `starfish`, `aquacrop` | `port`, `watertemple`, `monument1`, `monument2`, `monument3`, `monument4`, `monument5`, `monument6`, `monument7`, `algae`, `clathrus`, `bridge`, `atoll`, `algaespawn` | `fishing`, `riding2`, `fishingsimple`, `aquabase` | `aquatism (15)` |
| `ocean` | 2 | `fish`, `whale`, `starfish`, `aquacrop` | `watertemple`, `algae`, `clathrus`, `atoll`, `algaespawn` | `sailing`, `freediving`, `pescetism`, `marinelife` | `aquatism (15)` |
| `field` | 3 | `crop`, `fruit`, `spores` | `city`, `road`, `windmill`, `sawmill`, `growforest`, `temple`, `forge`, `monument1`, `monument2`, `monument3`, `monument4`, `monument5`, `monument6`, `monument7`, `sanctuary`, `icebank`, `mycelium`, `clathrus`, `market`, `canal` | `basic` | - |
| `mountain` | 4 | `metal` | `mountaintemple`, `sanctuary`, `clathrus` | `climbing` | `climbing (15)` |
| `forest` | 5 | `game`, `spores` | `road`, `clearforest`, `burnforest`, `lumberhut`, `foresttemple`, `forge`, `sanctuary`, `mycelium`, `clathrus`, `canal` | `basic` | `archery (15)` |
| `ice` | 6 | - | `monument1`, `monument2`, `monument3`, `monument4`, `monument5`, `monument6`, `monument7`, `outpost`, `icebank`, `icetemple`, `clathrus` | `basic` | - |
| `wetland` | 7 | - | `port`, `mycelium`, `clathrus`, `atoll`, `fertilize` | `basic` | - |
| `mangrove` | 8 | - | - | - | - |

*Entered once known*: the techs that let a player's land units enter the terrain (the rules also store a number per entry, which the engine does not read). *Defence bonus tech*: the tech that gives units standing on the terrain the 1.5 times defence bonus; the number is the stored value.

## Resources

| Resource | idx | Spawns on | Improvement that harvests it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `none` | 0 | - | - |
| `game` | 1 | `forest` | `hunting`, `enchantanimal` |
| `crop` | 2 | `field` | `farm` |
| `fish` | 3 | `water`, `ocean` | `fishing` |
| `whale` | 4 | `ocean` | - |
| `metal` | 5 | `mountain` | `mine` |
| `fruit` | 6 | `field` | `harvestfruit` |
| `spores` | 7 | `field`, `forest` | `fungi`, `harvestspores` |
| `starfish` | 8 | `water`, `ocean` | `starfishing` |
| `aquacrop` | 9 | `water`, `ocean` | `aquafarm` |
